What should I do?

Tornadoes: Monitor weather.gov for warnings. If a tornado warning is issued for your area, seek shelter immediately in an interior room on the lowest floor.
Earthquakes: Follow USGS guidance. Drop, cover, and hold on during shaking.
Hurricanes: Follow NHC advisories. Evacuate if ordered by local authorities.
